messages.subject: GCC Executive Profile | Energy, ESG, Government Relations & Country Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Rogue Recruitment Team,

Your executive-search coverage across GCC leadership, energy, industrial and utilities makes this a relevant introduction.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications.

I am targeting Director, VP, Country and Regional appointments across Saudi Arabia, the UAE and wider international markets where growth depends on institutional relationships, responsible development and coordinated execution. I am internationally mobile and open to expatriate appointments.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
